_comments: WHAT STILL HOLDS CONFIRM ON THIS ORDER (golive #340). Its own dot-json so it conflicts with no other
change to the remote operations. Called by the order form so its 'Before this can be confirmed' list
carries the concession refusals the server's confirm gate would give.

fields.Name: Confirm Readiness
fields.Description: The concession problems that would make confirm refuse a saved, unbooked order, one sentence each in the wording confirm refuses with: a concession awaiting approval, a line priced or discounted below its catalog price with no approved Price concession, a line whose product needs sale approval with none recorded. Read-only. Runs the same check confirm runs, over the saved order, so the order form's list cannot disagree with the refusal. A booked or voided order returns no problems.
